stem:
Avni compares writing large numbers with a new landmark symbol for every power, versus using place value.

Which two claims correctly explain place-value numerals?

options.text: Place value still works if each digit keeps a fixed absolute value in every position.
The same digit can mean ones or sixties depending on its position, so no new symbol is needed for each landmark.
Place value uses position to decide a symbol's value rather than inventing a separate symbol for every landmark number.
Place value is found by squaring a digit's position number.

teacher.key_rationale: Position decides value, so one digit set covers many landmarks. Fixed absolute digit values omit the position condition. Squaring position numbers is outside this place-value hinge.
